actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is low; conserve suggests 30% contribution but average contribution is below 30%, so conditional cooperation raises it. To also punish Resident2 for two low rounds, keep enough funds for punishment cost.

So we should contribute full wallet? That seems reasonable. So action contribute amount 21.6.

Also need broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1, so round5 broadcast norm. So broadcast message.

But conserve rule lower priority than punish? Punish is earlier than conserve but after conditional. We could keep some wallet to punish. Need cost 3, so keep at least 3 after contribution. So contribution = wallet -3 =18.6. Must satisfy conditional increase? Baseline 80% =17.28, extra 30% =6.48 total 23.76 but we cap at 18.6, still meets increased? Not exactly extra but okay. We'll contribute 18.6.

Now punish Resident2 amount 10.
